description: Use for questions like 'does NIS2 apply to my company?', 'are we an essential or important entity?' or 'is a company of this size and sector in scope?'. Indicates whether the NIS2 Directive applies to an organisation and in which category (essential or important), from its sector, size and type, applying Arts. 2 and 3 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555 and the size rule of Recommendation 2003/361/EC. An indication only: national law and the member state's list decide.

national_security_or_law_enforcement.description: Public administration working in national security, public security, defence or law enforcement (Art. 2(7))

provider_type.description: Special provider types covered regardless of size (Art. 2(2)(a), 2(4))
